body.x: Electronics and Telecommunications Research Institute(ETRI) introduced its super-speed downloading technology at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which ran Oct. 26-29 at COEX.
ETRI introduced AnyTOP, the high-speed cloud virtual desktop system. This technology is an in-memory based virtual module desktop system that can be used anytime in mobile phones and other devices.

The older system is too slow to download large-sized data. When AnyTOP technology becomes available to the public, it would be possible to download large-sized data in seconds. It can be used in companies, organizations, academic institutions, and industrial zones.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
